prompt: Create a monochrome anime-style portrait of a beautiful young adult businesswoman standing in a busy modern business district during rush hour. She has medium-length wavy dark hair with loose windblown strands, delicate facial features, subtle makeup, and a small earring. She wears a sharp black business suit jacket over a crisp white collared shirt and holds exactly 1 item: a structured black leather briefcase with a handle and metal clasp, cradled in both hands near the lower foreground. The background is a canyon of tall glass office buildings with exactly 8 prominent building masses visible, strong perspective lines, reflective windows, and bright backlight filtering between skyscrapers. Include a crowd of commuters in dark business suits walking away and around her, softly blurred by depth of field; keep them secondary and anonymous. Use pure black-and-white / grayscale rendering, high-contrast cinematic lighting, glossy highlights on hair and suit, soft rim light from behind, realistic urban atmosphere, polished manga illustration detail, shallow depth of field, vertical composition, no color accents, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张黑白动漫风格的肖像，主角是一位 美丽的年轻职场女性，她正站在高峰时段繁忙的现代商业区中。画面采用半身像，呈现四分之三侧身角度，她回眸看向观众，带着自信柔和的微笑，拥有一双灵动的大眼睛。她留着 中长波浪深色秀发，几缕发丝随风飘动，五官精致，妆容淡雅，佩戴着小巧的耳环。她身穿干练的 黑色商务西装外套，内搭挺括的白色衬衫，双手捧着一件物品：一个带有手柄和金属扣的黑色皮革公文包，置于画面下方前景。背景是高耸的玻璃写字楼群，清晰可见 8 栋主要建筑，具有强烈的透视感，窗户反射着光线，明亮的背光在摩天大楼间穿梭。画面中包含一群身着深色商务装的通勤者，他们正从她身边走过，背景经过景深虚化处理，保持次要且模糊的状态。采用纯黑白/灰度渲染，高对比度电影级布光，头发和西装带有光泽高光，背后有柔和的轮廓光，营造真实的城市氛围，呈现精致的漫画插画细节，浅景深效果，竖构图，无色彩点缀，无文字，无水印。
